programme.title: Boligrådet
programme.desc: Vi skal snakke om krafttak for grønnere løsninger og mer rehabilitering av gamle bygg.

programme.title: Nabolaget
programme.desc: I Arctanderbyen bor PR-ekspert Lise Kristensenhun i en klassisk hageby-villa, med utsikt over hele Oslo. Arctanderbyen er en av Oslos mindre kjente hagebyer, men faktisk var det Norges første av sitt slag!

programme.title: Flipp med Emilie
programme.desc: Vi blir kjent med Emilie, som sa opp en lederstilling i en stor norsk bank for å leve av boligflipping. Nå er hun på jakt etter en ny leilighet å fornye!

programme.title: Boligrådet
programme.desc: Hva skal til for å gjøre hverdagen enklere hjemme? En av landets største livsstil-influensere gjester studio med svarene som har hjulpet henne.

programme.title: Vi på Saltbrygga
programme.desc: I denne episode dukes det for storstilt fest blant beboerne på Otium. Og gutta er ikke vonde å be......når de vet hva som venter i andre enden!

programme.title: Rom for Suksess
programme.desc: Grensen 9B ligger midt i Oslo sentrum, et bygg som har knekt koden for lønnsomt ombruk. Her har vi sett hvordan ombruk kan gi nytt liv til et kontorbygg, med alt fra baneskinner til parkett som har blitt gjenbrukt.

programme.title: Boligrådet
programme.sub-title: Hva skal til for å bygge mer bærekraftige byer?
programme.desc: Innovasjon og grønne løsninger står i fokus når FutureBuilt gjester studio. Riksantikvaren har delt ut store midler og vi hører om hvilke som blir prioritert.

programme.title: Vi på Saltbrygga
programme.desc: I denne epsioden skal vi se hvordan beboerne på Otium holder interessene sine ved like - og hvordan de utfordrer seg selv ved å skape nye interesser i fellesskap med andre.

programme.title: Bygningsarven
programme.desc: Risør, også kjent som Den hvite by ved Skagerrak, har ett av de mest intakte bygningsmiljøene fra gammel tid. Her forenes bygningsarv med kystkultur, når byen arragerer Trebåtfestival.

programme.title: Boligrådet
programme.desc: Vi skal ut i hagen, inn på soverommet og få dagsaktuelle bolignyheter i dagens episode.

programme.title: Herlige hjem
programme.desc: Malerinnen Rita er opptatt av å samle på gjenstander og skape oaser der hun kan føle seg inspirert. Muskelterapeut Christian har mørke rom med stemningsfull belysning der grønne planter og vakker personlig kunst dekorerer hovedstuen.

programme.title: Hunting Hitler
programme.desc: Lenny og Gerrard gjør et overraskende funn i en ramponert flyhangar i Nord-Tyskland. Mike og James søker i en østerriksk innsjø etter et gjemmested med hemmelige dokumenter etter nazistene.

programme.title: The Universe
programme.desc: Bli med forskerne som leter gjennom universet på jakt etter alternative jordkloder.

programme.title: Rome: Rise & Fall of an Empire
programme.desc: Da Trajan ble erklært for keiser, skulle han gjenoppbygge imperiet og gjøre det til sitt mektigste noensinne.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: Det har alltid funnes historier om mennesker med overnaturlig styrke, fart og overnaturlige evner. Er det mulig at disse historiene skyldes romvesen som en gang har bodd på jorda?

programme.title: Ancient Top 10
programme.desc: De gamle grekerne fant opp filosofi, demokrati og…robotikk? Fra en dødsstråle lagd av Arkimedes til Herons automatiske dører, hvilken av det antikke Hellas' teknologier viser seg å være mest avansert?

programme.title: Evolusjon
programme.desc: Hvordan var evolusjonen til de flygende skapningene? Vi ser nærmere på utviklingen til flygerne, fra små virveldyr til himmelens kjemper.

programme.title: Secret History of Humans
programme.desc: Fra besettelsen av silke til Konstantinopels fall, oppdagelsen av Amerika og den industrielle revolusjon; jakten på luksus har formet vår historie og evolusjon.

programme.title: Secret History of Humans
programme.desc: For omtrent 10 000 år siden begynte menneskene med jordbruk. Men da avlingene sviktet, ble jordbrukerne stilt overfor en ny trussel: krig. Dette ble begynnelsen på våpenkappløpet.

programme.title: The Unxplained With William Shatner
programme.desc: Mange drømmer om å få ny identitet, men hvor går grensen mellom etterligning og forvandling? Gjennom å late som man er en annen, kan man virkelig bytte identitet?

programme.title: Superhaienes hovedvei
programme.desc: Reis til enden av Australias haimotorvei. Finn ut om Greenly Island i sør er en rasteplass for migrerende hvithaier, og se etter bevis på en genetisk sammenheng mellom nordlige oksehaier og deres søskenbarn i kjøligere områder.

programme.title: Dyreakutten
programme.desc: Bergingsarbeider Jo henter en pelikan som har svelget en fiskekrok, og Sam hjelper en nyfødt flaggermus som sitter fast i et gjerde. Dyrlege Tim hjelper en gretten koala med en øyeinfeksjon, og en klumpete pytonslange skaper masse trøbbel for nykommer Ruby.

programme.title: Vill himmel
programme.desc: Få med deg den evige jakten på vann som definerer livet til Afrikas ville dyr. Vær vitne til det største marine etegildet på Jorden, se hvordan kobraer samler solkraft, og bli med en flokk gnuer og elefanter på en av sine store vandringer.

programme.title: Vill himmel
programme.desc: Lær hvordan Sør-Amerikas rike mangfold av vær fører til et enda mer mangfoldig dyreliv. Utforsk de oksygenpustende trærne i Amazonas, følg buene til en stor elv, og møt flamingoer som trives i solens brennende UV-stråler.

programme.title: På jakt etter regnet
programme.desc: Oppdag se smarte måtene elefanter graver brønner på, og se hvor viktig det er med et plutselig regnskyll som fyller elvene. Sørg sammen med geparden Kuleta når løver tar livet av en av ungene hennes, og følg med når villhunden Phoenix slåss mot en gjeng hyener.

programme.title: The Kimberley: Australias ville vesten
programme.desc: Unngå skjelldekte og fjærkledde farer med wallabyer, se krageagamer kjempe om maker, og bli med på etegilde med nyklekkede krokodiller. Utforsk farlige stryk og forstår den kulturelle og biologiske viktigheten av en lokal elv i regnsesongen.

programme.title: The Kimberley: Australias ville vesten
programme.desc: Kjemp om råderett over elven med krokodiller, å få et lite innblikk i livene til en sjelden mangroveslange og en utrydningstruet nabarlek. Dra til sjøs for å se knølhvalmødre oppdra barna sine, og bli jaget av halvspekkhoggere.

programme.title: Dyrevern i byen
programme.desc: Det er vår og babyboom på senteret, og de ansatte er ville etter en gjeng nusselige pungrotteunger. Redningsgruppen redder en andemor og ungene hennes som befinner seg på en takterrasse høyt over byen.

programme.title: The Kimberley: Australias ville vesten
programme.desc: Unngå skjelldekte og fjærkledde farer med wallabyer, se krageagamer kjempe om maker, og bli med på etegilde med nyklekkede krokodiller. Utforsk farlige stryk og forstår den kulturelle og biologiske viktigheten av en lokal elv i regnsesongen.

programme.title: The Kimberley: Australias ville vesten
programme.desc: Kjemp om råderett over elven med krokodiller, å få et lite innblikk i livene til en sjelden mangroveslange og en utrydningstruet nabarlek. Dra til sjøs for å se knølhvalmødre oppdra barna sine, og bli jaget av halvspekkhoggere.

programme.title: Haiplaneten
programme.desc: Haiene er eldre enn dinosaurene og har streifet omkring i havene våre i over 400 millioner år, men det er først i dag at forskerne begynner å forstå hvorfor de har klart seg så godt.

programme.title: Dyrevern i Malawi
programme.desc: Amanda og Sophie flytter grenser for å slippe en vervetape med en brukket fot ut i villmarken igjen. Teamet får en utfordring når de skal sette sporingshalsbånd på en fire tonn tung elefant. Alma mottar en foreldreløs, katteaktig genett, og en antisosial bavian blir medlem av en flokk igjen.

programme.title: Dyrevern i Malawi
programme.desc: Bli med på redningsoperasjonen når Amanda og Mandy prøver alle triksene i boka for å hjelpe en hyene som har gått i en felle. Teamets plan om å slippe fri en flokk på 13 aper blir hindret av en operasjon i siste liten, samt noen lure utbryterartister.

programme.title: Superhaienes hovedvei
programme.sub-title: Forsiktig, det er mennesker der oppe!
programme.desc: Følg det sørlige teamet når de tester ny migrasjonsteknologi og verktøy som kan redusere haiangrep i et populært snorkleområde. Bli med på å fange og merke oksehaier med det nordlige teamet, som vil hjelpe svømmere med å unngå fødende mødre.

programme.title: Dyreakutten
programme.desc: Dyrlege Bec behandler koalaen Rachel, som har blitt bitt av en hund. De nye dyrlegene Ruby og Kerryn hjelper en flokk pungrotter med kløe. Redningsarbeider Dani befrir to koookaburraer som sitter fast, og dyrlege Tim opererer kneet til en småsvever.

programme.title: Superbeist
programme.desc: Opplev dyrs ferdigheter som er utenfor menneskets rekkevidde. Se hvordan saltvannskrokodiller oppdager den minste bevegelse med sine trykksensitive kupler. Oppdag duers interne GPS-system, og bruk en sjuende sans for å oppdage bytter med delfinene.

programme.title: Superbeist
programme.desc: Benytt biokjemiske våpen med naturens dyktigste og mest motstandsdyktige krigere. Slipp løs giftige bitt med komodovaraner, unngå giftige fiender med mangustgjengen, og se fugler bruke beinbrekkende kraft som forsvar mot giftige angrep.

programme.desc: Få et innblikk i verdens største biomassevandring, den årlige, 1600 kilometer lange sardinvandringen langs østkysten av Sør-Afrika. Se milliarder av disse bittesmå fiskene svømme slalåm mellom sultne rovdyr som listige seler og stupende havsuler.

programme.title: Dietrich Fischer-Dieskau: Last Words
programme.desc: The great German baritone Dietrich Fischer-Dieskau was greatly admired for his interpretive insight, note-perfect control of the tonal qualities, and shadings of color in his voice, for exceptional rhythmic sense and impeccable diction. His reputation as a lieder singer is so high – he had a repertoire of more than 3.000 songs – that it is easy to forget his extensive list of operatic roles. In this conversation Fischer-Dieskau reveals for the last time on camera the secrets of his outstanding career. His ‘Last Words’ provide a deep insight into the extraordinary artistic life of one of the most famous and prolific lieder singers of our time. Dietrich Fischer-Dieskau died in May 2012 at the age of 86.Subtitles available for this program with your remote control.

Accompagnés des experts Raj Bisram et David Harper, ces deux chasseurs d’antiquités sillonnent le comté à la recherche de trésors à vendre aux enchères à Nottingham.Rick découvre d’anciens graffitis médiévaux cachés dans la cathédrale de Norwich, tandis qu’Ian fait un détour vers le nord du Norfolk pour admirer la plus grande collection de soldats miniatures au monde.Mais un sage vieil homme japonais aidera-t-il Ian à triompher aux enchères ?

Elle est l’un des plus grands artistes français récompensée par un lion d’or à la Biennale de Venise en 2005. Elle emploi tissu, et objets du quotidien pour représenter l’intime. Mais elle reste aussi une artiste engagée. Installée dans la banlieue populaire de Paris, Annette Messager nous reçoit dans son atelier.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Degas : une passion de la perfection
programme.desc: Exhibition on screen nous emmène à travers les rues de Paris puis au cœur d’une superbe exposition au Fitzwilliam Museum de Cambridge, dont l’impressionnante collection d’œuvres de Degas est la plus représentative de Grande-Bretagne. Ayant bénéficié d’un accès exclusif à une grande variété d’œuvres rares, le film raconte l’histoire fascinante de la quête de perfection de Degas à travers l’expérimentation de nouvelles techniques et les leçons apprises en étudiant les grands maîtres.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Dans la seconde moitié du 19ème siècle, Edouard Manet (1832-1883) démontre une grande originalité dans ses peintures à représentation historique et ses portraits représentant des figures connues, comme le romancier Zola et le poète Mallarmé. Même s’il n’est pas reconnu comme étant le premier impressionniste, sa place de leader dans l’histoire de l’art se doit d’être souligné. Les scandales provoqués en 1863 par « Le Déjeuner sur l’herbe » ou « Olympia » tout deux exposés au Musée d'Orsay marque le début de la peinture moderne.Bonne visite !

Then they each start working on their creation. Finally, they end with a debrief, comparingand explaining their techniques.

programme.title: Little Sketches

programme.title: Architectures
programme.sub-title: Charlety, a stadium in the city
programme.desc: Découvrez un bâtiment de l’architecture classique, moderne ou contemporaine avec une « leçons d’architecture » conjuguant rigueur, plaisir et intelligence. Au stade Charlety, les architectes ont réussi à concilier les contraires : la grandeur monumentale du stade avec celle du quartier, la vie d’une cité sportive avec celle des bureaux. Situé à la porte de Gentilly à Paris, coincé entre le périphérique et le boulevard des Maréchaux, le stade Charléty est bordé des pavillons de la Cité universitaire, d’un cimetière et de HLM en briques rouges. Sur ce site difficile de huit hectares, marqué par les cinquante ans d’histoire de l’ancien stade Sébastien-Charléty, Henri Gaudin et son fils Bruno ont su implanter le volume massif d’un stade de 20 000 places couvertes, ainsi que les équipements sportifs et les bureaux commandés par la Ville de Paris. En concevant ce grand stade avec sa forme d’anneau gigantesque, ses gradins en ellipse et sa toiture aérienne, les architectes ont su traduire l’é.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Qui était Frida Kahlo ? Voyagez dans la vie d'une véritable icône, découvrez son art et la vérité qui se cache derrière sa vie souvent mouvementée. La combinaison d'interviews, de commentaires et d'une exploration détaillée de l'art de Kahlo, offre un trésor de couleurs et un festin de vitalité. Ce documentaire personnel et intime offre un accès privilégié à ses œuvres, et met en lumière sa créativité fébrile, sa résilience et sa soif inégalée pour la vie.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Rembrandt at the National Gallery, London & Rijksmuseum, Amsterdam
programme.desc: Every Rembrandt exhibition is eagerly awaited, but this exhibition organized by London's National Gallery and Amsterdam's Rijksmuseum was an unprecedented event. The documentary highlights the historic Rembrandt exhibition, while tracing his life. Rembrandt is one of the greatest artists who ever lived, and this deeply moving documentary seeks to explore the truth about the man behind the legend.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Canaletto and the Art of Venice
programme.desc: Canaletto et l’art de Venise, un voyage en immersion dans la vie et l’art du célèbre peintre de Venise. Aucun artiste n’a su mieux capturer l’essence et le charme de cette ville que Giovanni Antonio Canal, plus connu sous le nom de Canaletto. La remarquable collection regroupe plus de 200 tableaux, dessins et eaux-fortes nous permet de partir à la découverte du talent artistique de Canaletto, de ses contemporains et de la ville qu’il a su reproduire avec génie. Le film ouvre également les portes de deux résidences royales officielles, Buckingham Palace et le château de Windsor, pour nous en apprendre plus sur l’artiste et sur Joseph Smith, l’homme qui a fait découvrir Canaletto à la Grande-Bretagne.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Claude Monet est probablement le peintre impressionniste le plus célèbre du mouvement. Le terme « impressionnisme » est notamment dérive d’une de ses peintures « Impression, soleil levant » (1872). Cette exposition retrace les grandes étapes de la carrière prolifique de Monet tout en se concentrant sur les tableaux de ce maître de l’art à ne pas manquer comme : « La Gare Saint-Lazare », « Les Coquelicots », « Les Meules », « Série des Cathédrales de Rouen » exposé dans les 4 coins du monde comme au Musée des Beaux-arts de Boston et sans oublier « Les Nymphéas » exposé au musée de l'Orangerie à Paris.Bonne visite !

De son côté, l’amoureuse des animaux Ching découvre l’histoire d’un homme qui, au XIXe siècle, a risqué le ridicule et la ruine pour protéger le bétail.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Without Camille Pissarro, there is no Impressionist movement. He is rightfully known as the father of Impressionism.It was a dramatic path that Pissarro followed, and throughout it all he wrote extensively to his family. It is through these intimate and revealing letters that this gripping film reveals Pissarro’s life and work.Born in the West Indies, Pissarro found his passion in paint as a young man in Paris, and by the age of 43 had corralled a group of enthusiastic artists into a new collective. Their first show was scorned by the critics, but the group had acquired a new name: the Impressionists. For the next 40 years Pissarro was the driving force behind what has today become the world’s favourite artistic movement.The Ashmolean Museum has a long tradition of excellence. As the UK’s first ever public museum (it opened its doors in May 1683) it houses a wonderfully rich collection, including the remarkable Pissarro archive. With exclusive access to most extensive archive of.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Painting the Modern Garden - Monet to Matisse
programme.desc: Passionné d’horticulture, Monet reste sans conteste le maître de la peinture de jardins dans l’histoire de l’art, mais il n’était pas seul. Des artistes tels que Van Gogh, Bonnard, Picasso et Matisse ont utilisé le jardin comme thème fort de leur œuvre. Ces grands artistes, ainsi que bien d’autres noms célèbres, sont rassemblés dans une exposition innovante du Cleveland Museum of Art et de la Royal Gallery of Arts de Londres. De l’exposition elle-même à la beauté des jardins d’artistes comme celui de Monet à Giverny, nous partons en voyage pour découvrir comment le jardin moderne était utilisé pour explorer de nouvelles idées radicales et merveilleuses.

programme.desc: Born in Damascus, Syria, Ammar Abd Rabbo lived in Libya and Lebanon before moving to France at the age of 12. He has been working as a press photographer since 1990, and has signed more than sixty covers for well-known magazines. Ammar Abd Rabbo is not a war photographer, but has covered several conflicts, such as Iraq (2003), Lebanon (2006), Libya (2011), as well as several trips to Syria, in 2013 and 2014, to show the daily life and resistance of the inhabitants, rather than the military life.

Jennifer and Phil detour to hear about Fred Karno, the man credited with inventing slapstick comedy. While Patricia and Mark learn how a surgeon from Reading used his incredible sense of smell to successfully treat soldiers injured in World War One.And, Phil gets custard pied – what’s not to love?

programme.title: Masterpieces Unveiled
programme.desc: The image of the wealthy merchant from Lucca Giovanni Arnolfini shown together with his wife in the intimacy of their comfortable home in Bruges has always been considered the brilliant figurative proof of the commercial and artistic relations between Italy and Flanders in the 15th century. However, there has been a certain amount of doubtful attention devoted to the figures for some time; in fact, the hypothesis that one of the maximum masterpieces of portraiture of all times may not depict the Arnolfinis at all, but the van Eycks, is not entirely new. It had already been cautiously suggested by the Director of London’s National Gallery over a century and a half ago, when the painting was purchased by the great museum, but the idea was soon cast aside by the objections of specialists. Other doubts about the couple’s identity have cropped up a number of times, juggled back and forth amongst the abundant historic information on the painting, archival research, and allegorical theori.

programme.title: Masterpieces Unveiled
programme.sub-title: Bosch, The Garden Of Earthly Delights
programme.desc: This is Triptych of Earthly Delights: how did the great masterpiece by Jeroen Anthoniszoon van Aken, known as Hieronymus Bosch, come to be created, when was it painted, what was it used for, and what does it really represent? No one knows; for most of bosch’s works no documents or precise information about buyers exist. even the dating itself is complicated. Historians, archivists, and art critics have tried everything. A veil of mystery envelops his entire artistic production, giving rise to the most varied rumours but for now searching for clues in the local traditions, in the writings in latin, french, german and dutch, searching for possible iconographic precedents and parallels, peering into the murky mirror of magical rites and heresies, delving into alchemy treatises, and pulling out from the fog of history figures who had practically been forgotten. The search goes on, but for the time being we have no first-hand information. For almost all of bosch’s works, no conclusive d.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Lucian Freud, l'un des peintres britanniques les plus célèbres de notre époque, est également l'un des rares artistes du XXe siècle à s'être représenté dans un autoportrait avec une telle constance. Ses autoportraits donnent un aperçu fascinant à la fois de sa personnalité et de son évolution en tant que peintre, depuis son premier portrait peint en 1939 jusqu'au dernier. Grâce à des entretiens fascinants avec d'anciens modèles, des amis et d'éminents experts, ce documentaire intensément captivant révèle l'œuvre d'un maître qui représente une étude captivante sur la dynamique du vieillissement et le processus d'autoreprésentation.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: « J’envie les Japonais », écrivait Van Gogh à son frère, Théo. Grâce à l’exposition sur laquelle est basé ce film, « Van Gogh et le Japon », au musée Van Gogh d’Amsterdam, on comprend pourquoi. Bien que Vincent van Gogh n’ait jamais visité le Japon, il reste le pays qui a eu le plus d’influence sur lui et son œuvre. En se rendant dans les galeries d’art japonais à Paris et en créant sa propre image du Japon après des recherches approfondies, des collections d’estampes et de longues discussions avec d’autres artistes, la découverte des œuvres japonaises entraîna la carrière de Van Gogh dans une nouvelle direction très excitante.

programme.desc: Créé à la fin du XIXe siècle par le collectionneur Richard Wallace, ce musée privé de Londres conserve une très belle collection de peintures européennes. On peut entre autres y admirer Le cavalier riant de Frans Hals ou le Portrait de Titus, le fils de Rembrandt. La peinture française du XVIIIe siècle dans sa veine galante et rococo y est particulièrement bien représentée avec, bien sûr, le chef-d’œuvre de la peinture libertine de Fragonard, Les hasards heureux de l’escarpolette.Bonne visite !

programme.title: Architectures
programme.desc: Architecte et urbaniste, Kenzo Tange est l'un des architectes les plus influents de sa génération; il a initié le Japon à l'architecture moderne, découverte dans le travail des maîtres. Il fut, en 1987, le premier Japonais à recevoir le prix Pritzker, la plus haute distinction mondiale en architecture. Il faut remonter à la défaite du Japon après la deuxième guerre mondiale et aux années qui ont suivi : l'occupation du Japon par les Américains, son absence de la scène internationale, sa lente reconstruction économique pour comprendre la vraie origine des 2 gymnases olympiques construits par Kenzo Tange pour les Jeux Olympiques de 1964. Il est rare qu'un bâtiment incarne autant d'ambitions : celles d'un architecte et d'une équipe de 25 jeunes architectes et urbanistes, celles d'une ville, celles d'un pays décidé à redevenir une puissance mondiale.

Réalisés au fusain ou à la mine de graphite, ses œuvres sombres et souvent très réalistes suscitent à la fois admiration et effroi. Puissant et complexe, l’art de Jérôme Zonder captive par ses prouesses techniques et questionne notre rapport à la violence.

programme.desc: Pablo Picasso est l’un des plus grands artistes au monde, et jusqu’à sa mort en 1973, il était le plus prolifique. Comment tout a commencé ? Comment s’est construit Picasso ? Après avoir été trop longtemps ignorées, il est temps de se concentrer sur les jeunes années de l’artiste et son éducation qui lui ont permis d’accomplir l’extraordinaire. Trois villes ont joué un rôle-clé : Malaga, Barcelone et Paris. "Le jeune Picasso" les traverse et explore leur influence sur l’artiste, en analysant des œuvres spécifiques de ses débuts.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Né à Aix-en-Provence dans le Sud de la France, Paul Cézanne (1839-1906) était un grand peintre français lors de la deuxième moitié du 19ème siècle. Artiste de base impressionniste, il initie le post-impressionnisme et le cubisme à travers ses oeuvres. Dans ses natures mortes et ses « Baigneurs », il innove grâce aux formes géométriques, permettant d’influencer les artistes cubistes qui le succèdent. Il a choisi de peindre la « Montagne Sainte-Victoire » une vingtaine de fois. Remarquez la magnifique simplicité de l’oeuvre « Nature morte aux pommes et aux oranges » ou la concentration illustré dans « Les Joueurs de cartes » tout deux exposés au Musée d'Orsay.Bonne visite !

programme.title: Architectures
programme.sub-title: Le familistère de Guise, une cité radieuse
programme.desc: André Godin imagine pour ses ouvriers, dans la lignée des phalanstères de Charles Fourier, un habitat communautaire aux allures de palais. De 1860 à 1968, le Familistère de Guise, cité bâtie pour 1800 habitants par le grand industriel fouriériste Jean-Baptiste-André Godin (1817-1889), a été le théâtre d'une expérience sociale restée unique par son audace, son ampleur et sa durée. L'invention d'une architecture et d'un urbanisme "unitaires" est l'un des aspects originaux et pionniers de l'aventure familistérienne. Ce "Palais social" a constitué une véritable utopie en actes qui suscite aujourd'hui à nouveau l'intérêt des historiens, des sociologues, des économistes, des urbanistes ou des architectes.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Le collectionneur danois : de Delacroix à Gauguin
programme.desc: Wilhelm Hansen fut un homme d’affaires visionnaire, qui vécut au Danemark au XIXème siècle. Il fut l’un des rares collectionneurs à s’intéresser aux peintres impressionnistes, à une époque où ils étaient attaqués et dénigrés. Le film nous amène dans la maison d’été de Hansen dans la banlieue de Copenhague et nous fait visiter l’extraordinaire exposition à la Royal Academy de Londres consacrée à sa collection.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Après deux ans d’exposition itinérante, en 2015 "La Jeune Fille à la perle” est retournée au musée Mauritshuis de La Haye. Du haut de ses 350 ans, l’éternelle Jeune Fille a toujours su conserver son aura de mystère et son charme. La preuve, c’est le nombre de curieux (1,2 millions) qui ont accouru pour l’apercevoir lors de son séjour au Japon. Le documentaire cherche à découvrir les nombreuses énigmes de cet extraordinaire tableau et de son créateur mystérieux - Vermeer. Qui était cette fille ? Pourquoi et comment Vermeer a-t-il peint ce tableau ? Venez voyager dans le temps pour découvrir Johannes Vermeer, visiter le charmant musée de La Haye et répondre à toutes ces questions.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: David Hockney à la Royal Academy of Arts
programme.desc: David Hockney, généralement considéré comme l’un des artistes britanniques les plus populaires, connaît un succès mondial grâce à ses expositions à Londres, New York, Paris et ailleurs qui attirent des millions de spectateurs. Devenu récemment octogénaire, Hockney ne semble pas avoir l’intention de lever le pied ni de perdre son audace légendaire. Ce film révèle des interviews intimes et inédites et se concentre sur deux expositions à succès ayant eu lieu en 2012 et 2016 à la Royal Academy of Arts Londres. Le réalisateur Phil Grabsky a bénéficié d’un accès privilégié pour célébrer sur grand écran ce génie créatif du XXIe siècle.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: With his considerable production of more than 6,000 works, Auguste Renoir took part in the emergence of the impressionist movement even if he were to distance himself from it later to assert a more personal style. This visit begins with his most famous masterpiece, the “Ball at the Moulin de la Galette”. You will also rediscover the “Dance in the City” and the “Piano Lesson” exposed at the Joslyn art museum as well as “Claude Renoir in Clown Costume”, a portrait of his son who was later to become one of France’s greatest film directors exposed at the Orangerie Museum in France Enjoy your visit!

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Discover or re-discover the masterpieces of the greatest painters of history through our documentary series Within The Frame. From impressionists to surrealists, from Leonard Da Vinci to Paul Cézanne, every episode will immerge you into a virtual tour of a paintings collection. You will see the most impressive paintings ever made and won't miss a single detail.

programme.title: Graffiti World
programme.desc: Graffiti World is a short program dedicated to contemporary urban art around the world. Each episode explores a specific city, highlighting iconic works of street art. Local soundscape accompanies the images for an authentic, commentary-free immersion. The program showcases the creativity and diversity of artistic expression in public spaces. An invitation to discover the richness of graffiti as an art form in its own right.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Deux légendes de la comédie britannique, Ronni Ancona et Jan Ravens, sont accompagnées des antiquaires Phil Serrell et James Braxton pour ce Road Trip. Partant de la ville de Redcar, dans le North Yorkshire, ils se dirigent vers une vente aux enchères à Stockport, dans le Cheshire.Jan se laisse emporter et dépense tout son budget, tandis que Ronni se régale d'une paire de bottes en verre très kitsch.Lors d'un détour, Jan découvre pourquoi les habitants de Hartlepool pensaient qu'un singe était un Français, et Ronni reste bouche bée lorsque Braxton enlève ses vêtements. Sacré moment !

programme.title: Masterpieces Unveiled
programme.sub-title: Bosch, The Garden Of Earthly Delights
programme.desc: This is Triptych of Earthly Delights: how did the great masterpiece by Jeroen Anthoniszoon van Aken, known as Hieronymus Bosch, come to be created, when was it painted, what was it used for, and what does it really represent? No one knows; for most of bosch’s works no documents or precise information about buyers exist. even the dating itself is complicated. Historians, archivists, and art critics have tried everything. A veil of mystery envelops his entire artistic production, giving rise to the most varied rumours but for now searching for clues in the local traditions, in the writings in latin, french, german and dutch, searching for possible iconographic precedents and parallels, peering into the murky mirror of magical rites and heresies, delving into alchemy treatises, and pulling out from the fog of history figures who had practically been forgotten. The search goes on, but for the time being we have no first-hand information. For almost all of bosch’s works, no conclusive d.

programme.title: Masterpieces Unveiled
programme.desc: The image of the wealthy merchant from Lucca Giovanni Arnolfini shown together with his wife in the intimacy of their comfortable home in Bruges has always been considered the brilliant figurative proof of the commercial and artistic relations between Italy and Flanders in the 15th century. However, there has been a certain amount of doubtful attention devoted to the figures for some time; in fact, the hypothesis that one of the maximum masterpieces of portraiture of all times may not depict the Arnolfinis at all, but the van Eycks, is not entirely new. It had already been cautiously suggested by the Director of London’s National Gallery over a century and a half ago, when the painting was purchased by the great museum, but the idea was soon cast aside by the objections of specialists. Other doubts about the couple’s identity have cropped up a number of times, juggled back and forth amongst the abundant historic information on the painting, archival research, and allegorical theori.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: John Singer Sargent: Fashion and Swagger
programme.desc: John Singer Sargent is known as the greatest portrait artist of his era. What made his ‘swagger’ portraits remarkable was his power over his sitters, what they wore and how they were presented to the audience. Through interviews with curators, contemporary fashionistas and style influencers, Exhibition on Screen’s film will examine how Sargent’s unique practice has influenced modern art, culture and fashion.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: In the Artist's workshop series, we offer you a privileged meeting with an artist, or the discovery of an artist or an important place for the history of art. Whether they are painters, visual artists, sculptors... These people all have the same passion for art and this show is an opportunity to enter their different universes, to discover what drives them, inspires them and maybe that will give rise to vocations.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Hopper’s work is the most recognisable art in America – popular, praised, and mysterious. Countless painters, photographers, filmmakers and musicians have been influenced by his art – but who was he, and how did a struggling illustrator create such a bounty of notable work?This new film takes a deep look into Hopper’s art, his life, and his relationships. From his early career as an illustrator; his wife giving up her own promising art career to be his manager; his critical and commercial acclaim; and in his own words – this film explores the enigmatic personality behind the brush….

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Phil Grabsky, réalisateur récompensé à plusieurs reprises, pose un regard neuf sur celui qui est sans conteste l’artiste le plus aimé au monde en utilisant les mots du peintre lui-même. Moi, Claude Monet révèle de nouvelles facettes de l’homme qui a donné naissance au mouvement impressionniste grâce à un tableau et qui fut certainement l’un des peintres les plus influents et renommés du XIXe et du début du XXe siècle. Tourné à travers l’Europe, sur les lieux où il a peint, Moi, Claude Monet est une exploration filmique inédite et intime de certains des décors cultes les plus appréciés de l’art occidental.

programme.title: The decisive moment
programme.desc: In this episode, we meet Ammar Abd Rabbo, press photographer. He says of his work, that he likes to write thanks to photos. He does not define himself as a war reporter but rather as a generalist reporter. He likes to diversify: one day he wants to photograph the Cannes Film Festival, another day he wants to photograph a political event...

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Les animatrices vedettes Nicki Chapman et Jules Hudson s'échappent à la campagne pour partir à la chasse aux antiquités avec Natasha Raskin et Phillip Serrell. C'est une bataille filles contre garçons, chaque équipe disposant de 400 £. Le voyage commence à Wormsley, dans le Herefordshire, puis les deux équipes se dirigent vers le pays de Galles et l'Oxfordshire, avant de finir à North Finchley, à Londres, pour une vente aux enchères.En chemin, les filles rencontrent un fabricant de sabots qui sculpte les chaussures à la main. Pendant ce temps, les garçons se rendent au Herefordshire Light Infantry Museum pour en apprendre davantage sur l’implication du régiment à Gallipoli.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Les légendes de la scène et de l'écran, Charles Dance et Geraldine James, rejoignent les experts en antiquités Natasha Raskin et Will Axon pour cette excursion dans le Wiltshire.Charles trouve une paire de vases en argent de l'époque édouardienne qu'il espère rentabiliser lors d'une vente aux enchères dans l'Essex. Geraldine, elle, tombe sur un homme dans la rue avec un secrétaire Empire français du XIXe siècle. Il lui en coûte une petite fortune - le pari sera-t-il gagnant ?Charles se retrouve dans le cockpit d'un très vieil hélicoptère tandis que Geraldine apprend comment un petit quartier de Swindon datant de 170 ans a influencé la création du NHS moderne.

programme.title: Masterpiece
programme.desc: Rembrandt: without a doubt the greatest painter in the Netherlands. Admired all over the world, especially for his play with light and dark. He was a Dutch celebrity avant la lettre, the superstar of the Golden Age ... A master of portraying human emotions, especially when it comes to his self-portraits. Technical virtuoso, but also ruthlessly honest. Rembrant painted his first self-portrait when he was 22. A small, but technically very refined work: "Self-portrait at an early age." Is the team able to unravel some of the secrets of Rembrandt's shadow play?

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Actor and charmer Nigel Havers and his canny, deal-making chum (and ex-agent) Michael Whitehall explore the West Country. Travelling by Bentley and TVR, they’ll have £400 each and expert advice from Margie Cooper and James Braxton. But what will do best at the auction... Nigel’s old cockle bucket or Michael’s tambourine? Plus there’s a trip to see some Bristol Savages and bit of Georgian elegance with the story of ‘The King of Bath’.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.sub-title: Lynne Faulds Wood and John Stapleton
programme.desc: Un Road Trip en couple de célébrités – les journalistes primés John Stapleton et Lynn Faulds Wood.Ils sont rejoints par Thomas Plant et Margie Cooper pour cette aventure. Avec 400 £ chacun, les équipes commencent à Wrightington, dans le Lancashire, et se dirigent vers Stockport pour une vente aux enchères.Lynn et Thomas se retrouvent littéralement jusqu'aux genoux dans des antiquités en cherchant de vieilles boîtes à biscuits, tandis que Margie tente de convaincre John que des lampes rares feront un joli profit.John apprend comment un Américain a révolutionné les transports publics britanniques, et Lynn découvre pourquoi on traite du lait de serpent à Liverpool.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Les chefs télévisés Aldo Zilli et Ching He-Huang s’affrontent lors de ce Road Trip à travers le sud-est de l’Angleterre, accompagnés des experts Natasha Raskin et Paul Laidlaw.Aldo mise sur une bague en or malgré les conseils des experts, tandis que Ching espère que des antiquités d’origine orientale feront un beau score aux enchères dans le nord de Londres.En chemin, Aldo fait une halte pour rencontrer Jill, une doyenne de 200 ans qui fournissait autrefois la population en farine. De son côté, l’amoureuse des animaux Ching découvre l’histoire d’un homme qui, au XIXe siècle, a risqué le ridicule et la ruine pour protéger le bétail.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: It’s a journey into antiquity with glamorous historians Suzannah Lipscomb and Kate Williams. Paired with experts David Harper and Catherine Southon they Road Trip from Bletchley in Buckinghamshire to an auction in London. There’s also opportunity to hear how Mrs Beeton became the first ‘domestic Goddess’ and why Luton played a critical role in the fashion world when hats were de rigueur daily wear. David and Suzannah gamble on a giant ant while Catherine and Kate plump for a very large tea urn.

From impressionists to surrealists, from Leonard Da Vinci to Paul Cézanne, every episode will immerge you into a virtual tour of a paintings collection. You will see the most impressive paintings ever made and won't miss a single detail.

programme.title: Photo Contest
programme.desc: In each episode of Photo Contest, two contestants compete on an imposed theme such as rock'n roll, Japan or architecture. They have one hour to take the best possible photographs before editing them for 30 minutes in a studio. The photographs they have selected are then presented to Agnès Grégoire, editor-in-chief of PHOTO magazine, who will have to choose the best photographer.

programme.title: An hour with
programme.desc: Take an hour break to discover the work of a French painter, Georges Seurat. You will discover his labour with « Ile de France » landscape, Study for « a Sunday afternoon at the grande jatte », Study for « La grande jatte ».

programme.title: An hour with
programme.desc: Take an hour break to discover the work of a French painter, Jean-François Millet. You will discover his labour with Naked woman sleeping, Two bathers or The church at gréville.

programme.title: Video Art
programme.desc: Street art, performances, digital art... Because the new forms of Art and their invigorating character, even iconoclastic, have been able to attract a new public until now refractory to go inside the interior of our beautiful museums.

programme.desc: Massage studio will show you the best massage techniques in places which will make you dream. Let us take care of you! Lay down, relax and forget all your problems.

programme.title: Namaste Yoga
programme.sub-title: Release and Restore: A Sequence for Your Spine
programme.desc: Release and Restore is a sequence that brings you full circle through a series of poses that create space for reflection. You will release tension in your spine while attuning to the changes even the smallest actions create. What change will you make today?

programme.title: Home training
programme.desc: This episode of Home Training focuses on a full-body workout using a chair as the main tool. Guillaume and Sabrina guide viewers through simple yet effective exercises like squats, leg raises, and glute-strengthening moves. They emphasize the importance of warming up properly to prevent injuries and maximize effort. The entire body is engaged, from legs to arms, with exercises designed for home workouts. Fun and accessible, this session is perfect for solo practice or a family workout.

programme.title: Pilates
programme.desc: Stay in shape with our pilates courses!

programme.title: Namaste Yoga
programme.sub-title: Prana Flow: Open Your Shoulders and Hips
programme.desc: This vinyasa flow allows the practitioner to notice moments of stillness and transformation with every breath. Power and Prana calls for a constant presence of mind and steadiness of breath. It is in this state you learn when to stabilize and when to let go.

programme.title: Deco Masters
programme.desc: Aurélie, 36, is the latest to enter the race. For several years now, this native of Lille has been making a living from her little-known but high-profile passion: upcycling. Upcycling requires a lot of qualities, and Aurélie, rather quiet and reserved, hopes they'll help her stand out once the competition gets underway. Completely redecorating a room remains a huge challenge for her, even if she has a few styles that are close to her heart.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: It is in the heart of the Sarthe that Julie begins her new tour. Located in the Pays de la Loire region, the Sarthe department is the gateway to the French Grand Ouest. In the Haut Maine region, Le Mans is a city of art as well as a historic city, which played a decisive role in the development of the automobile. The country of Le Mans is distinguished by the diversity of its heritage, having kept in its stones the imprints of all eras. This region is notably renowned for its poulet de Loué, its capon and many other regional specialities. Let's go for a real Sarthe gourmet journey, with veal rouelles à la mancelle, roast poularde and seasonal fruit tart.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Julie nous donne rendez-vous à Bordeaux après avoir arpenté le pays de Blaye, visité deux fois le bassin et parcouru les terres du Libournais à deux reprises, il fallait bien s’arrêter un jour dans la capitale du Bordelais ! N’y-a-t-il pas meilleure saison que le mois de septembre pour découvrir la perle d’Aquitaine, plus souvent appelée « Cité du vin » ? Julie donne rendez-vous à ces habitants pour découvrir les traditions mais aussi les projets plus récents de cette ville chargée d’Histoire et de gastronomie.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Aujourd’hui, les plus gourmands ne devraient pas être déçus puisque c’est le chocolat qui est mis à l’honneur. Découvert par les mayas il y 2500 ans et plus largement ensuite par les Aztèques, le chocolat fait partie aujourd’hui des produits préférés des français. Et qu’on ne s’y trompe pas : au même titre que la cuisine a ses grands chef, le chocolat a aussi ses grands chocolatiers. Coté recettes, Julie fera découvrir un gâteau qu’on ne fait qu’à Saint Émilien et qui associe le chocolat au macaron, avant de rejoindre le Pays Basque pour un dessert qui ne manque pas de piment. Nous grimperons ensuite en montagne à la rencontre d’une cuisinière d’origine suisse qui fait des pains au chocolat à sa façon. Enfin, vous verrez que le chocolat nous réserve de nombreuses surprises : il possède de nombreuses vertus et s’utilise aussi pour le bien être.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Tendre et savoureux, l’agneau tient une place prépondérante dans la cuisine festive mais aussi dans celle de tous les jours. Du Pays Basque au Cotentin en passant par Paris, Julie part donc sur les routes de France à la découverte des différentes races et types d'élevage existant à travers le pays. Il faut dire que la France a l'une des productions les plus variées au monde. Il existe plus d'une quarantaine de races répertoriées en 5 catégories : précoces, d’herbage, rustiques, mérinos et laitières. Mais plus qu’à la race, c’est à la façon dont ils sont alimentés qui intéresse les fins connaisseurs. Julie nous fait découvrir ses producteurs et cuisiniers de ce met raffiné !

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Today, we're off to discover summer fruits, which are harvested from June to August: peaches, melons, strawberries, raspberries... We'll then head to the cherry capital, Céret, and cook blueberries, strawberries and an apricot charlotte.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: Dans cet épisode, Luana Belmondo invite son amie Eleonora Galasso pour une pizza party ! Elles vont d'abord préparer une pâte maison. Ensuite, elles cuisineront une capriciosa avec des anchois, des câpres et du jambon, ainsi qu'une pizza fritta avec de l’origan et de la sauce tomate.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: Dans cet épisode, Luana Belmondo cuisine des pois chiches. Comme ils sont originaires du Moyen-Orient, elle décide de préparer des recettes libanaises. Au menu : fallafels avec des pois chiches, du kumquat, des épices, de la cannelle, et blettes aux pois chiches, persil, menthe et boulgour.

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.desc: Feeding the family is the concern of billions of people every day on the planet and it has been completely forgotten. We will also see that we, as consumers, can change things by changing our eating habits because our health and sustainable development depend on it. We fly over Paris to discover the cultivated plains, the intensive breeding in the Beauce, the pesticides in Guadeloupe and the green Camargue where the ecosystem is threatened, until India where the limits of the green revolution are reached.

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.desc: The incredible diversity of flora and fauna, the fight against climate change, the balance between growth and sustainable development: these are all battles being fought on five continents. Yann Arthus-Bertrand takes us on this expedition. We're off to Gabon to discover the Ivindo National Park and Port-Gentil, then on to Sri Lanka in Kandi. Back to Gabon we go to Libreville, then Lambaréné to talk about turtles and the health of the local people. Finally, off to Dhaka-Bangladesh.

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.desc: Dans ce volet, Yann Arthus-Bertrand lève le voile sur les produits achetés par les hommes. Presque tous nos achats ont une incidence directe sur notre environnement. Direction la Japon pour parler de l’impact des nouvelles technologies, puis la république du Congo à Bukavu pour la récolte du coltan. Comment notre consommation totale affecte-t-elle l'environnement ? Quelles marques permanentes imposons-nous à notre planète ? Comment différencier les achats utiles des achats inutiles ?

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.desc: Canada is the second largest country in the world by land mass and contains amazing natural resources: 7% of the Earth’s drinking water is spread over the country’s thousands of lakes. Forests cover 45% of the territory. Yann Arthus-Bertrand goes off to discover these resources with those whose job it is to protect them. He takes a look at the ecological balance sheet of the world’s eighth-largest economic power.

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.desc: Canada is the second largest country in the world by land mass and contains amazing natural resources: 7% of the Earth’s drinking water is spread over the country’s thousands of lakes. Forests cover 45% of the territory. Yann Arthus-Bertrand goes off to discover these resources with those whose job it is to protect them. He takes a look at the ecological balance sheet of the world’s eighth-largest economic power.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: If you're a nature enthusiast and a fan of outdoor cooking, the upcoming season is perfect for barbecue enthusiasts! Our journey will take us to Aube, nestled in the heart of the Brévonnes forest, and then to the Massif des Bauges, where grilling and snow create a unique combination. Afterward, we'll explore the Libournais region, where we'll uncover cooking techniques that make use of vine shoots, which are plentiful in the area. Just a short distance from the vineyards, we'll arrive at another corner of Gironde, the Blaye region, where the cooking method remains consistent but features a distinctly local ingredient: eel.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Today, Julie takes us down a different kind of yellow-brick road, one that tastes of childhood and gourmet delights: the road of sweets. France may be famous for its gastronomy, but it's not to be outdone when it comes to pastries and confectionery - quite the opposite. “Bêtises” from Cambrai, "Berlingots” from Carpentras, "Calissons” from Aix-en-provence, every region in France has its own sweet or confectionery.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: Dans cet épisode, Luana accueille Héloïse Brion, créatrice de "Miss Maggie's Kitchen

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: Luana Belmondo offers a recipe for celeriac risotto with citrus powder. She will also prepare black rice with spring vegetables. A real treat for the taste buds!

programme.title: The Great Gardening Challenge
programme.desc: This week’s heat sees professional teams from opposite ends of the UK compete as they’re challenged to create amazing spaces in just 2 days on a budget of £5000, for the Care for Veterans’ care home in Worthing, a specialist care home for elderly and disabled military veterans. Experienced garden designers and builders, James Hutchison and Stuart Gibson have travelled to the South Coast all the way from London. While their opponents, Manoj Maldé and Mark Holman, garden designers who collaborate on show gardens together, have only had to travel from Hertfordshire and Kent. With a brief that includes making sure the gardens are wheelchair friendly and low maintenance the teams come up with very different designs. James and Stuart are faced with a potentially disastrous problem they aren’t used to dealing with back in Scotland. But can they resolve it in time and finish their garden?

programme.title: The Wonderful World of Crafting
programme.desc: Four passionate hobby crafters showcase their talents at the Crafty Vintage Fair at Lowther Castle in Penrith, Cumbria. From intricate needle-felt creations to imaginative plastic sculptures and beautifully crafted wooden furniture, each maker strives to turn their passion into success. This episode captures their creative journeys, the challenges they face, and the thrill of presenting their work at a prestigious fair. Will their crafts capture the hearts of visitors and lead to life-changing opportunities?

programme.title: The Great Gardening Challenge
programme.desc: In this week’s episode, professional garden design partners Jon Smith and Adam Woolcott take on Catherine and James Burrage from Yorkshire. Their challenge is to deliver amazing garden spaces on a budget of £5000 for the Knightswood Day Care Centre in the heart of the Essex countryside within sniffing distance of the North Sea. The centre offers a lifeline to mainly elderly local people who have physical or mental disabilities or who live alone. With a brief from the centre that includes sensory elements, seating and a potting shed, both teams have ambitious designs but can they complete them in just 2 days?

programme.title: The Wonderful World of Crafting
programme.desc: The series begins with three makers taking their items to Clare Priory Craft Fair in Suffolk. Heather quit her job to devote her time to making clay fantasy figures, so she needs to start making her hobby pay. John rents a huge studio full of quilting machines and fabrics to realise his passion, and Toni is devoted to crochet.

programme.title: The Great Gardening Challenge
programme.desc: This week’s heat sees a pair of established designers taking on a less experienced up and coming pair, as they’re challenged to deliver amazing spaces on a budget of £5000, for a community park in Norris Green, Liverpool. Friends Sue Spout and Dean Bolton-Grant from Harrogate in Yorkshire both own their own garden businesses and between them have decades of experience and include royalty amongst the people they’ve worked for. Despite living opposite sides of the country Tamara Bridge and Kate Savill have collaborated on a number of show gardens since winning medals for young garden designer of the year. Faced with designing gardens for an open public area that has in the past been neglected and suffered from vandalism what type of gardens will the designers create? And who will be victorious?

programme.desc: Séquence joyeuse et élégante, "Grace et Gratitude" ouvre l’avant du corps avec une série d’extensions dynamiques vers l’arrière. Faites rayonner la lumière de votre cœur en apprenant à respirer avec ampleur. Cette pratique encourage une action guidée par des intentions d’amour, de pardon et de gratitude.

programme.title: Deco Masters
programme.desc: Aujourd'hui, c'est l'heure du verdict. Les quatre chantiers sont terminés. Les candidats vont faire face aux critiques de leurs adversaires et découvrir leurs notes. Mais surtout, les propriétaires vont enfin rentrer chez eux et découvrir leur pièce entièrement redécorée. Que penseront-ils de leur nouvel intérieur ? Quels points vont-ils attribuer ? Car leurs notes peuvent tout faire basculer et renverser le classement actuel. Qui repartira avec les 2000 € et le titre d’As de la déco de la semaine ?

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: We are in the middle of the harvest season, a perfect opportunity to discover the most beautiful French vineyards.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Julie reprend la route à bord de sa petite voiture rouge pour faire honneur à l’un de ses fruits favoris : la châtaigne. Julie ira à la rencontre de plusieurs producteurs en Ardèche, cuisinera la soupe traditionnelle de la région aux côtés de la pétillante Marithé. Elle fera aussi la recette des marrons glacés maison, avant de filer en Corse pour travailler la farine de châtaignes et les feuilles de son arbre. Ce périple s’achèvera comme toujours avec une recette de chef astucieuse et cette-fois ce sera Claude Brioude qui s’y collera ! Ce chef aime bousculer les codes et travaillera la châtaigne avec le poisson, deux produits de saison que l’on n’a pas forcément l’habitude de marier.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: C’est à nouveau sur les routes de France que l’on retrouve aujourd’hui Julie pour parler d’un produit incontournable des tables françaises : le fromage. Plus qu’un engouement gourmand, plus qu’une friandise de fins de repas, le fromage est associé à l’image de la gastronomie française, et d’ailleurs reconnu patrimoine immatériel par l’UNESCO. Les français ne s’y sont pas trompés : avec près de 1 000 variétés - des pâtes molles, aux pâtes cuites, persillées, ou encore pressées, et avec 45 Appellations, nous sommes les plus gros consommateurs de fromage au monde !

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Julie takes you through the Pyrénées Orientales, then Corsica, before making a stop on the Côte d'Azur, and concludes her journey between Rungis and Paris... all to explore the world of citrus fruits! These fruits add flavor, zest, and seasoning to any recipe, making them indispensable in the kitchen. They bring the warmth and sunshine of the South of France and the exoticism of distant lands. While we're all familiar with lemons, clementines, and grapefruits, Julie introduces us to a thousand other varieties.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: This week, it is 80 kms from the capital, in Fontainebleau, that Julie is putting down her bags. Fontainebleau, a name famous throughout the world, a magical name which evokes for some a forest, for others a castle, a name which still shines with its royal history. The forest of Fontainebleau has inspired the art world since the beginning of the 19th century. Landscape painters such as Corot and Millet drew inspiration for their works there. But Fontainebleau has many other treasures in its bag, and gastronomy is part of its heritage. This is what Julie will discover through three recipes: Quail with grapes, raspberry and poppy pie and crayfish grave.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: Dans cet épisode, Luana Belmondo met la Normandie à l'honneur ! Avec le président de la région, Hervé Morin, elle prépare des pommes pochées dans un sirop de cannelle, ainsi que des moules... à sa façon.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: Avec son amie Myriam, Luana Belmondo prépare deux recettes à base de safran. Au programme : orecchiette (petites pâtes italiennes) avec de la saucisse, et lotte au citron confit avec sa purée d’asperges.

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.desc: Yann Arthus-Bertrand continues his world tour in the name of sustainable development and environmental protection. He shows us the incredible wealth of our planet and goes to meet those who propose solutions to perpetuate farming and cultivation models. We discover how to feed ourselves without destroying in the Rhône-Alpes region, how to preserve the forest in Indonesia, but also the extent of GMOs in Alsace as well as the advantages of terroir in Provence-Alpes-Côte-D'azur.

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.desc: Ces reportages sont surtout l'occasion pour Yann Arthus-Bertrand de dresser un état des lieux de la planète et de dénoncer certains comportements humains, à l'origine de dégradations environnementales et climatiques dramatiques, voire irréversibles. Direction Tokyo puis le Kenya vers un refuge animalier. Puis vers le mont Fuji pour apprendre à y vivre ainsi que de tout le plastique qui encombre les mers. Les reportages aborderont des produits du quotidien, choisis pour leurs pratiques de production destructrices à la fois pour les hommes et pour l'environnement.

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.desc: Dans ce volet, Yann Arthus-Bertrand lève le voile sur les produits achetés par les hommes. Presque tous nos achats ont une incidence directe sur notre environnement. Direction la Japon pour parler de l’impact des nouvelles technologies, puis la république du Congo à Bukavu pour la récolte du coltan. Comment notre consommation totale affecte-t-elle l'environnement ? Quelles marques permanentes imposons-nous à notre planète ? Comment différencier les achats utiles des achats inutiles ?

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.desc: To better understand the role of these explosive mountains located all over the world, on land or under the sea, Yann Arthus-Bertrand goes to Italy, the country with the most active volcanoes in Europe. Accompanied by volcano expert Jacques-Marie Bardintzeff, the photographer meets those people who have chosen to live with « their » volcano, in spite of the dangers involved in this kind of proximity.

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.desc: Canada is the second largest country in the world by land mass and contains amazing natural resources: 7% of the Earth’s drinking water is spread over the country’s thousands of lakes. Forests cover 45% of the territory. Yann Arthus-Bertrand goes off to discover these resources with those whose job it is to protect them. He takes a look at the ecological balance sheet of the world’s eighth-largest economic power.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Eating flowers might appear unconventional, but we often consume them without even realizing it. Consider artichokes, for instance : they are essentially large, unopened flowers. Capers are the preserved buds of flowers soaked in vinegar, and cloves are dried flower buds. We also find courgette flowers, saffron pistils, orange blossom water used to flavor pastries, and the violet sweets that evoke memories of our childhood. In addition to adding aesthetic appeal and providing a dose of vitamins to our plates, flowers elevate the flavors of a dish and can even serve as a vegetable substitute.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Julie takes us on a journey of spices and aromatic plants. Spices are a call to travel, to faraway lands and to the unknown. On her journey, Julie will introduce us to the famous black pepper.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: Luana Belmondo gives you ideas for recipes that are easy to prepare using a wok! Thanks to this cooking method, you can create delicious, quick recipes using leftovers from your fridge or cupboard.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: Coconut milk is easy to cook, and can be used with a wide range of ingredients, from stews and soups to sweet recipes.

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.sub-title: Défendre l’eau c’est défendre la vie - Partie 1
programme.desc: The oceans cover more than 70% of the Earth's surface. The sea is the largest natural environment on our planet and remains virtually unexploited. In Brittany, in the Seven Islands. Then in the Bay of Saint-Brieuc, in the middle of a sea of green algae. In Brittany, intensive agriculture has developed over the last thirty years. In New Caledonia, the coral reef is the second largest in the world and could be threatened by the construction of a nickel mine. In Normandy, in the Botanical Garden of Vauville, an extraordinary garden has plants from all over the world. Also in the Archipelago of Chausey in Normandy with the highest tides in Europe. Or the Mont Saint Michel. As a result of silting up and man-made works, the Mont was no longer an island. In Italy, in Venice, on the verge of drowning, major development work, industrialisation and tourism have upset the environment. In New Caledonia, flying over the heart of Voh is surrounded by the largest lagoon in the world. 24,000 km2 prot.

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.desc: We end up at Yellowstone National Park in the United States, it is located in the first natural park created in the world. In Peru, the Amazon rainforest is suffering from massive deforestation. The desert on Beijing's doorstep is regularly hit by sandstorms. Some experts predict that the Chinese capital could be threatened by deserts within a hundred years. In Montana, American agricultural productivity has an ecological and human cost. Engineer Marc Dufumier explains how mechanisation is undermining the natural balance. In Brazil, agrofuels have made it possible to reduce dependence on oil, cut urban air pollution and even limit greenhouse gas emissions. In Los Angeles, human activities have disrupted the greenhouse effect and exacerbated it. Today, the Earth is heating up.

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.desc: In Florida, the Everglades swamp is being restored at great expense. 15 billion dollars are being invested over thirty years to save the water supply of the entire region. In California, on the crests of the Tehachapi hills, the world's largest wind farm is being discovered. In China, the fermentation of excrement produces gas, mainly methane, which, when burned, is transformed into energy called biogas. In California, the Taft oil field was discovered, one of the largest in the world: nearly 10,000 wells on over 52,000 hectares. Then Haiti fights to save itself from deforestation. In Utah, Salt Lake City is a good example of how we live today: there are 37 cities in the world with more than 8 million inhabitants. In the Eure-et-Loir region of France, they decided to build the ideal house to give a house that saves 85% of energy.

programme.title: Utemmede Filippinene
programme.desc: Kast det ut i det krystallklare havet for å utforske Tubbataha-revet, som hviler på en inaktiv undervannsvulkan der grunne laguner gir beskyttelse for havskilpadder og tigerhaier. Kom deg opp i trærne med spøkelsesaper når de jakter insekter.

programme.title: Præriehundenes rike
programme.desc: June må ta seg av den foreldreløse valpen Vince når han prøver å bli med i flokken hennes. I Highlands leter Scarletts uredde unger etter to grevlinger, og det får dødelige konsekvenser. I Flatlands håper Ruby at tøff kjærlighet kan hjelpe sønnen hennes Kip til å lære seg å spise selv før melken hennes går tom.

programme.title: Præriehundenes rike
programme.desc: Præriehundene i New-Mexico stilles overfor mange farer. På slettene må June gjøre noe med invasjonen av lopper.

programme.desc: Fra menneskets synspunkt er verdens tropiske korallrev undervannsparadiser, men for de svømmende beboerne er det et spis eller bli spist-miljø styrt av store rovdyr. programme.desc: Et team av forskere og en filmfotograf lette etter store makrellhaier i farvannene nord for New Zealand. Sammen med en lokal fisker, som har fisket i dette havområdet i flere tiår, støter de på en rekke makrellhaier som bare blir større og større. Mens arten er truet andre steder på kloden, avdekker teamet en bestand av makrellhaier som kanskje er i ferd med å komme seg igjen.

programme.title: Hammerhead Sharks Up Close with Bertie Gregory
programme.desc: Bertie Gregory drar til Baja-halvøya i Mexico for å finne et av havets mest særegne rovdyr: hammerhaien. En gang var den et vanlig syn, men nå har bestanden stupt. Bertie undersøker hvorfor, og om det er noe håp for den ikoniske haien.

programme.title: South America's Weirdest Animals
programme.desc: Sør-Amerika er fullt av det ekstreme. Enorme områder med skog, sletter og fjell. Det er lettere sagt enn gjort å overleve. Men når det blir vanskelig, forvandler de ville beboerne seg til særinger. Flere tusen år med merkelig evolusjon har gjort dette enorme kontinentet til mutantenes land. Forvent det uventede, for her er det underlige normalt.

programme.title: South America's Weirdest Animals
programme.desc: Sør-Amerika er et kontinent med ekstreme variasjoner, der man finner flere hundre tusen kvadratkilometer med skog, sletter og fjell. Det er tøft å overleve her. Noen dyr har utviklet seg til å bli veldig store eller svært små, og begge strategiene skal øke sjansen for å overleve.

programme.title: South America's Weirdest Animals
programme.desc: Sør-Amerika er et frodig og mangfoldig kontinent. Fantastiske landskaper huser skapninger som har tilpasset seg til livet her. Det er ikke gitt at de overlever, for rovdyrene finnes overalt. Digre delfiner og det største kattedyret i Amerika er blant rovdyrene som lever i den ville naturen.

programme.title: World's Weirdest Animal Faces
programme.desc: En hyllest til verdens mest upretensiøse dyr. Vi får se de merkelige trekkene til noen av verdens snodigste skapninger.

programme.title: Den fantastiske dr. Pol
programme.desc: Gjør deg klar til litt liv og røre! Fra brautende fugler til vonde hover, setter veterinærene i gang med å helbrede poter, kjever, til og med dun på lykkeanden hans. Dyrlegene fører en episk kamp for å redde en ku som sliter med å føde, dr. Lisa behandler en husky som har blitt påkjørt av en lastebil, og dr. Nicole undersøker et valpekull som har mange problemer. Polerne ønsker velkommen til sin nyeste pelsbaby, Christy, en vilter bengalsk kattunge.

programme.title: Den fantastiske dr. Pol
programme.desc: Halter, klumper og kamelpukler! Fra husdyr til eksotiske dyr, dr. Pol og teamet hans er vitne til en rekke skader i det harde vinterværet. Følelsene blir intense når dr. Nicole behandler sin egen elskede beagle. Dr. Pol finner ut at noe er på gang med en bøllete kamel, og det er alle menn til pumpene når en akuttfødsel med 11 valper settes i gang.

programme.title: Predator v Prey
programme.desc: Vi er kjent som voldsomme drapsmaskiner, og bruker etterforskning for å undersøke hvordan løver jakter store byttedyr. Med et nytt perspektiv på måten disse ekspertrovdyrene forfølger, jager og dreper, ser vi på at en løvinne er avhengig av list for å mate sine nyfødte unger, mens en fryktløs stolthet prøver å ta ned en gigantisk afrikansk elefant.

programme.title: Predator v Prey
programme.desc: Eksperter på å få ned noen av de største dyrene på planeten, bruker vi etterforskning for å utforske hva som gjør geparder til så effektive rovdyr. Gjennom et nytt perspektiv på taktikken som brukes av disse kunnskapsrike morderne, ser vi hvordan en ung gepardmor lærer sine tre unger jaktens hemmeligheter.

programme.desc: Fra menneskets synspunkt er verdens tropiske korallrev undervannsparadiser, men for de svømmende beboerne er det et spis eller bli spist-miljø styrt av store rovdyr. Men mindre jegere beviser at størrelse ikke er alt, slik som dragefisken med giftige pigger, sjøkneleren med kjapp reaksjonsevne og sepiablekkspruter med sin foranderlige hud og tentakkelharpuner. Deres utrolige talenter gjør dem til konkurransedyktige jegere.

programme.title: Sharkfest
programme.desc: Et team av forskere og en filmfotograf lette etter store makrellhaier i farvannene nord for New Zealand. Sammen med en lokal fisker, som har fisket i dette havområdet i flere tiår, støter de på en rekke makrellhaier som bare blir større og større. Mens arten er truet andre steder på kloden, avdekker teamet en bestand av makrellhaier som kanskje er i ferd med å komme seg igjen.

programme.title: Utemmede Filippinene
programme.desc: Kast det ut i det krystallklare havet for å utforske Tubbataha-revet, som hviler på en inaktiv undervannsvulkan der grunne laguner gir beskyttelse for havskilpadder og tigerhaier. Kom deg opp i trærne med spøkelsesaper når de jakter insekter.

programme.title: Big Cat Planet
programme.desc: Store kattedyr ses kanskje på som den ultimate klisjéen for ville dyr, men de er midt i en global kamp for å overleve. De er sterke og farlige, og nå går de i klinsj med mennesker mer enn noensinne. Denne ville safarien avslører deres motstands- og tilpasningsdyktighet. Geparder jakter fra biler, jaguarer sniker seg innpå bytte under vann og rundt båter, og Indias løver jakter i byens gater. Kjente arter og oppførsler skaper nytt drama, med avsløringer som bekrefter hvorfor store pattedyr er de farligste rovdyrene.

programme.title: Built to Survive
programme.desc: Urfolkslærer Phil Breslin setter kursen mot konstant hete, luftfuktighet og regn i Australias regnskoger for å finne ut hva som kreves for å overleve. I tretoppene finner Phil de sky trekenguruene og babyene deres samt Australias største slange, den dødelige ametystpytonen. På bakken fungerer de fargerike kasuarene som regnskogens gartnere.

programme.title: Præriehundenes rike
programme.desc: Det er regntid i Dogtown. Scarlett og familien forsterker hiet før flommen rammer dem, men de får også ubudne gjester før stormen kommer.

programme.title: Præriehundenes rike
programme.desc: Eiendomskrangler blir løst litt annerledes i Dogtown. I jakten på sitt første hi møter Pelt og Digit på grevlinger og præriehunder som beskytter territoriet sitt.

programme.title: Predator v Prey
programme.desc: Av alle de store katterovdyrene, skiller leopardene seg ut med sin eksepsjonelle drapsekspertise. Vi kommer tett på en hunnleopard, og avslører hvordan disse erfarne morderne bruker listighet, styrke og fysikk for å følge og fange alt fra impalaer og gnuer til steinbit og stork.

programme.title: American Amazon
programme.desc: Bli med på en reise inn i Nord-Amerikas hemmelige villmark.

programme.title: Predator v Prey
programme.desc: Vi er kjent som voldsomme drapsmaskiner, og bruker etterforskning for å undersøke hvordan løver jakter store byttedyr. Med et nytt perspektiv på måten disse ekspertrovdyrene forfølger, jager og dreper, ser vi på at en løvinne er avhengig av list for å mate sine nyfødte unger, mens en fryktløs stolthet prøver å ta ned en gigantisk afrikansk elefant.

programme.title: Predator v Prey

programme.title: American Amazon

programme.title: The Living Edens
programme.desc: Til tross for at farene konstant lurer, trives en rekke dyr på Costa Rica. De lever av overfloden jorda og sjøen sørger for.

programme.title: United States of Animals
programme.desc: I USA finner noen av de mest fascinerende migrasjonene sted nærmere enn du tror, mange av dem i din egen bakgård. Fra kanadatraner i Nebraska til monarksommerfugler i California, dyrene pakker kofferten og reiser hvert år for å slå seg ned i nye hjem, og noen av disse migrasjonene kan finne sted i hjembyen din. Denne feltguiden viser hvor du kan oppleve noen fantastiske migrasjoner.

programme.title: Predator v Prey
programme.desc: Vi er kjent som voldsomme drapsmaskiner, og bruker etterforskning for å undersøke hvordan løver jakter store byttedyr. Med et nytt perspektiv på måten disse ekspertrovdyrene forfølger, jager og dreper, ser vi på at en løvinne er avhengig av list for å mate sine nyfødte unger, mens en fryktløs stolthet prøver å ta ned en gigantisk afrikansk elefant.

programme.title: Predator v Prey
programme.desc: Eksperter på å få ned noen av de største dyrene på planeten, bruker vi etterforskning for å utforske hva som gjør geparder til så effektive rovdyr. Gjennom et nytt perspektiv på taktikken som brukes av disse kunnskapsrike morderne, ser vi hvordan en ung gepardmor lærer sine tre unger jaktens hemmeligheter.

programme.title: Predator v Prey
programme.desc: Vi er kjent som bakholdets mestere, og bruker rettsmedisinsk teknologi for å utforske hvordan nilkrokodiller har blitt eksperter på å jakte på trekkende flokker av gnuer og sebraer. Med et forbløffende nytt perspektiv på pasienten og presis taktikk de bruker for å sette opp drapet, ser vi på hvordan en snikende mannlig krokodille sikter mot sitt neste offer.

programme.title: Predator v Prey
programme.desc: Vi ser nærmere på overlevelsesevnene til noen av de sterkeste rovdyrene i verden – isbjørner. Følg livene til en mor som sliter med å skaffe mat til de to ungene sine og en ung hann som holder på å sulte ihjel. Vi ser på taktikken disse dyrene bruker for å spore opp, forfølge og angripe bytter som sel, hval og valross.

programme.title: Predator v Prey
programme.desc: Av alle de store katterovdyrene, skiller leopardene seg ut med sin eksepsjonelle drapsekspertise. Vi kommer tett på en hunnleopard, og avslører hvordan disse erfarne morderne bruker listighet, styrke og fysikk for å følge og fange alt fra impalaer og gnuer til steinbit og stork.

programme.title: Den fantastiske dr. Pol
programme.desc: Den elskede klinikk-huskatten, Tater, blir syk og teamet jobber sammen for å redde ham. Charles debuterer med en ny stil, dr. Pol behandler en stut som elsker å tygge ved og dr. Brenda tar seg av en labrador med mageproblemer. En nysgjerrig chihuahua spiser en giftig matbit, så dr. Lisa gir en den klissete motgift og dr. Nicole hopper inn for å redde en fødende geitemama.

programme.title: Den fantastiske dr. Pol
programme.desc: Selv om klinikken må stenge under en snøstorm, tar Pols veterinærer fortsatt hånd om dyr i nød. Flere dyr har blitt skadet under uværet, så dr. Pol og teamet rykker ut for å behandle skader i hofter og hover. Dr. Lisa tar seg av en vanskelig fødsel, mens dr. Brenda imponerer under arbeidet med kyr og veddeløpshester.

programme.title: Lion
programme.desc: Etter en desperat leting gjenforenes Kio og Summer med brødrene, men livet i utkanten av flokkens territorium er nådeløst. Summer sliter med å jakte for de uerfarne sønnene og forberede dem på et liv alene, og kampen for å overleve tærer på. Når et lett bytte blir for fristende, får det konsekvenser som forandrer Kios liv for alltid. Han tvinges til å bli selvstendig lenge før tiden, og nå må Kio og brødrene hans lære å overleve på egen hånd.

programme.title: Lion
programme.sub-title: Chapter Two: A Band Of Brothers
programme.desc: Kio overlever mirakuløst et bøffelangrep, men utfordringene har så vidt begynt. Han er bare tolv uker gammel – den yngste og mest sårbare i flokken. Skal han en dag bli konge, må han vinne brødrenes respekt og finne sin plass. Akkurat da han endelig blir akseptert, slår tørken til, og det blir kamp om maten. Summer må derfor ta et drastisk valg for å sikre Kios fremtid.
